performance.verdict: Meta dark 4 days; CPL efficiency gain is real but fragile at $33/day pace.

findings.text: channel_dark:meta confirmed — spend reads $0 for Sep 9–12 (4 consecutive days), zero leads in same window; campaign has gone fully dark.
CPL improved 64.58% WoW to an implied ~$16–17 on only $33.16/day avg spend — efficiency gain is real but volume dropped to 5 leads over last active 7 days.
3 overdue SOW milestones unresolved by Aug 31: Marwan extension unsigned (gates next 3 months), SMS automation not live, Zoho Voice access not granted.
GHL pipeline shows 24 contacts vs 30 Meta-reported leads (28d) and 0 opportunities created — 6-lead gap suggests intake is not converting arrivals to pipeline at all.
GBP actions fell 47.62% WoW and IG reach dropped 63.95%; organic visibility contracting in parallel with paid going dark, reducing total brand touchpoints.

suggestions.text: Diagnose and restore 'Leads - August Re-Launch' immediately — 4 dark days, $0 spend, 0 leads; confirm billing, policy hold, or manual pause.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has been at $0 spend for 4 consecutive days (Sep 9–12) with zero leads recorded. Hamza/Hamdan must check the account today for a billing failure, policy hold, or accidental pause on 'Leads - August Re-Launch'. Success is confirmed spend resuming at the approved ~$65–75/day and at least 1 lead recorded within 24 hours of restoration. Escalate to Sohib if not resolved by Sep 14.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL intake pipeline: 0 opportunities created from 24 contacts (28d) — identify where leads are dropping before opportunity creation.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 24 contacts and 0 opportunities created over the 28-day window, meaning no lead has progressed to pipeline stage despite Meta delivering 30 reported leads. Andrew must audit the GHL workflow to find where contact-to-opportunity conversion is breaking — likely a missing automation step or manual review gap. Success is at least 1 opportunity created per 3 contacts within the next 7 days. Re-check Sep 20.

suggestions.text: Once Meta is live, watch daily CPL vs the $19–45 historical range for 3 days before any budget move.
suggestions.monday_update: The 64.58% CPL improvement during the last active spend period is encouraging but occurred at only $33/day — well below the $65–75/day SOW rate. Once the campaign is restored (S1), monitor CPL daily for 3 full days to confirm efficiency holds at full budget. If CPL stays within the $19–45 historical band, Sohib can approve a step back to $65–75/day. Re-check Sep 17.
